spec: C05-BUILD-SPEC.md 交付物 8 (Windows 路径变体 正斜杠盘符) — KNOWN-PROBLEMS.md P8/E7
description: file_path spelled with a drive letter immediately followed by a forward slash and forward slashes throughout (C:/Users/.../decisions.md, zero backslash characters anywhere). This is already hook.cjs's own internal normalized form for most of its pipeline, but it is listed explicitly in KNOWN-PROBLEMS P8/E7 as one of the concrete spellings a naive fast-path string match has historically let slip through unclassified, so it is kept in the matrix as a regression guard rather than assumed safe by construction. Only the shadow hook is a relevant consumer. Expect: a shadow log line is appended (never silent) and isMemory resolves true (correct judgment). Empirically confirmed via isolated probe before committing this fixture.
